full_prompt_en: A square flat-color painting shows an extreme close-up of a face assembled from interlocking blocks of red, yellow, orange, black, pink, and muted blue. The head turns slightly toward the right. The crop cuts off the top of the hair and most of the neck, making the face fill nearly every part of the frame. One ear presses against the left border, simplified into pale pink and black curved shapes. Two dark eyes look outward beneath heavy black brows; the eye at left is clearly lit by a thin pale band, while the eye at right sits deeper in shadow. A sharply angled white-and-yellow highlight forms the bridge and tip of the nose. A large black shadow covers much of the right cheek and nose side. The left cheek is built from orange, rust red, and a broad oval red patch, with a small cream highlight near the eye. A curved blue-green strip runs across the lower cheek and jaw. Full dark lips and a firm black chin shape occupy the lower right, while a yellow patch cuts into the jaw from below. A thin strip of striped clothing is barely visible near the lower left corner. The background remains a flat warm pink area at right and a deeper red-black field at left, with no setting or objects. The surface appears painted by hand: broad matte color blocks have slightly uneven edges and faint brush texture, but little traditional shading. Light is encoded by the placement of cream and yellow areas rather than a realistic cast beam. The palette is vivid and carefully balanced, with black providing the main structural contour and red carrying much of the visual energy. The close crop and direct gaze give the graphic face a strong, immediate presence.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形平涂色彩绘画呈现极近距离的面容，由红、黄、橙、黑、粉与低调蓝色互相咬合的色块组成。头略朝右转。画框裁掉发顶和大部分脖颈，使脸几乎占满全幅。一只耳贴在左边缘，简化成浅粉与黑色曲形。两只深眼从厚黑眉下望出；左眼由细浅色带照亮，右眼陷在更深阴影里。棱角鲜明的白黄高光构成鼻梁与鼻尖。大片黑影盖住右颊和鼻侧。左颊由橙、锈红和一大块椭圆红斑组成，眼旁有一处小奶油色亮点。一道弯曲蓝绿条带穿过下颊与下颌。丰满深色嘴唇和坚实黑下巴占据右下，下面有一块黄色插入下颌。左下角刚能看到一条有条纹的衣着。背景右侧为平面暖粉，左侧是更深红黑色域，没有场景或物件。表面有手绘感：宽大哑光色块边缘略不匀，带微弱刷痕，但少有传统明暗塑造。光由奶油与黄色区块的位置编码，而非写实投射光束。色盘鲜明而仔细平衡，黑色提供主要结构轮廓，红色承载大部分视觉能量。贴近裁切与直接目光让图形化面容有强烈的即时存在感。
style_prompt_en: Flat-color painting builds large forms from interlocking matte shapes with firm black structural areas and small cream highlights. Red, rust orange, mustard yellow, dusty pink, and a narrow blue-green accent are placed as distinct color territories rather than smoothly blended tones. Edges are mostly crisp but retain slight handmade irregularity and faint brush texture. Dark masses organize the composition, allowing warm saturated blocks to carry energy without losing legibility. A close crop magnifies the visual weight of each curved patch and angular cut. Illumination is implied by color placement and value contrast rather than realistic shadow falloff. The result is bold, direct, and rhythmically balanced across the square.
style_prompt_zh: 平涂色彩绘画以互相咬合的哑光形块建立大形，用坚实黑色结构区和小奶油色高光支撑。红、锈橙、芥黄、尘粉和一道窄蓝绿重点各占明确色彩疆域，而非平滑混合。边缘大多清楚，却有轻微手工不齐和淡淡刷痕。深暗大块组织构图，使饱和暖色块有能量又不失可读性。贴近裁切放大每块弯曲色斑与棱角切线的视觉重量。照明由颜色位置和明度对照暗示，而非写实阴影衰减。整体鲜明、直接，在方形画幅中有节奏地平衡。
theme_en: A close face assembled from bold red, yellow, black, and pink shapes
theme_zh: 一张近景面容由鲜明红、黄、黑与粉色形块拼成
name: Nina Chanel Abney
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
